endpoints.summary: Search Jira issues using JQL. Pass the JQL query and options (jql, fields, maxResults) in the JSON body. Jira Cloud search is POST /rest/api/3/search/jql.
Get detailed information about a Jira issue by key. Requires an issueKey (e.g. PROJ-123) obtained from a prior search_jira_issues result.

parameters.name: issueKey
parameters.description: the issue key, e.g. PROJ-123 (from search_jira_issues)

endpoints.summary: Create a new Jira issue. Pass project, issueType, summary and optional fields in the JSON body.
Update an existing Jira issue. Requires an issueKey — call search_jira_issues to obtain one. Editable fields go in the JSON body.

parameters.name: issueKey
parameters.description: the issue key to update (from search_jira_issues)

endpoints.summary: Add a comment to a Jira issue. Requires an issueKey — call search_jira_issues or get_issue to obtain one. Comment text goes in the JSON body.

parameters.name: issueKey
parameters.description: the issue key, e.g. PROJ-123 (from search_jira_issues)

endpoints.summary: Get available workflow transitions for a Jira issue. Requires an issueKey — call search_jira_issues to obtain one.
Transition a Jira issue to a new status. Requires an issueKey and a transitionId — call get_transitions to obtain both. Payload goes in the JSON body.
Get the list of all accessible Jira projects.
Get detailed information about a specific Jira project. Requires a projectKey (e.g. PROJ) — call get_projects to obtain one.

parameters.name: projectKey
parameters.description: the project key, e.g. PROJ (from get_projects)

endpoints.summary: Get information about the currently authenticated Jira user.
Get Jira issues assigned to the current user (excludes done/closed/cancelled by default). Options go in the JSON body.
Get Jira issues currently in progress assigned to the current user. Options go in the JSON body.
Get recently updated Jira issues assigned to the current user. Options (days, maxResults) go in the JSON body.
Assign a Jira issue to a user. Requires an issueKey — call search_jira_issues to obtain one. The accountId goes in the JSON body (use search_users to find it).
Search for Jira users by name or email to obtain their account IDs.
Search Confluence content using CQL (Confluence Query Language).

parameters.name: cql
parameters.description: the CQL query string, e.g. 'space=DEV AND type=page'

endpoints.summary: Get a Confluence page by ID with full content. Requires a pageId — call search_confluence or search_confluence_by_text first to obtain it.
Get a Confluence page by title and space key. Requires a spaceKey — call get_confluence_spaces to obtain one.

parameters.name: spaceKey
parameters.description: the space key, e.g. DEV (from get_confluence_spaces)

endpoints.summary: Create a new Confluence page. Pass spaceKey, title, content and content_format in the JSON body.
Update an existing Confluence page. Requires a pageId and the current version number, obtained from a prior get_confluence_page result. New content goes in the JSON body.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: the page ID to update (from search_confluence or get_confluence_page)

endpoints.summary: Get the list of all accessible Confluence spaces.
Get detailed information about a specific Confluence space. Requires a spaceKey — call get_confluence_spaces to obtain one.

parameters.name: spaceKey
parameters.description: the space key, e.g. DEV (from get_confluence_spaces)

endpoints.summary: Add a comment to a Confluence page. Requires a pageId (call search_confluence to obtain it) and comment text, both passed in the JSON body.
Simple text search across Confluence pages (no CQL required). Good for quick lookups.

parameters.name: cql
parameters.description: text search, submitted as a CQL text ~ query

endpoints.summary: Get a Confluence page via the v2 API with improved performance and optional public link. Requires a pageId obtained from a prior search_confluence result.
